questions.question: Can I return an opened laptop on day 8 if I have the original box and all accessories?
questions.answer: Yes. Opened laptops can be returned within 10 days of delivery, including on day 8, provided they’re in good condition, have no physical damage, and are returned with the original box, all accessories, manuals, and the invoice. [RR-001, RR-002]

questions.question: My Galaxy Buds3 Pro left earbud won't connect. Is this a known issue, and has the same problem been resolved for another customer? What fixed it?
questions.answer:
Yes. One Galaxy Buds3 Pro earbud—often the left—may fail to connect after pairing with a new phone. A previous customer had the same issue, and it was resolved by resetting the earbuds and pairing them again as a new device (KI-001, TCK-1001).

To try it: place both earbuds in the case, close the lid for 10 seconds, then reset them through the Galaxy Wearable app or by holding both touchpads for 7 seconds. Pair them again as a new device (KI-001).
